# Resource (hush_postgres_access_privilege)

Manage PostgreSQL access privileges in the Hush Security platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a PostgreSQL access privilege.
# With all_in_schema, object_names lists schemas rather than individual objects.
resource "hush_postgres_access_privilege" "example" {
  name        = "app-read-write"
  description = "Read/write access to application tables"

  grants {
    privileges    = ["SELECT", "INSERT", "UPDATE"]
    object_type   = "TABLE"
    object_names  = ["public"]
    all_in_schema = true
  }

  grants {
    privileges    = ["USAGE"]
    object_type   = "SEQUENCE"
    object_names  = ["public"]
    all_in_schema = true
  }
}

# A migration user that hands the objects it creates to an owner role with
# ALTER ... OWNER TO app_owner. The root credential's user needs ADMIN OPTION
# on app_owner (GRANT app_owner TO <root> WITH ADMIN OPTION).
resource "hush_postgres_access_privilege" "migrations" {
  name      = "app-migrations"
  member_of = ["app_owner"]

  grants {
    privileges   = ["USAGE", "CREATE"]
    object_type  = "SCHEMA"
    object_names = ["public"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the PostgreSQL access privilege

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the PostgreSQL access privilege
- `grants` (Block List) The list of privilege grants. At least one of grants or member_of is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--grants))
- `member_of` (Set of String) Roles the user is made a member of, with INHERIT and SET, so it can transfer what it creates to them (ALTER ... OWNER TO). The root credential's user needs ADMIN OPTION on each role, or SUPERUSER for a superuser role. Requires access-manager chart 0.34.0 or later on the deployments of policies using the privilege.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the PostgreSQL access privilege
- `type` (String) The type of access privilege

<a id="nestedblock--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

Required:

- `object_type` (String) The type of database object (TABLE, SEQUENCE, FUNCTION, SCHEMA, DATABASE)
- `privileges` (List of String) The list of PostgreSQL privileges (e.g., SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)

Optional:

- `all_in_schema` (Boolean) Grant on all objects of the given type in the specified schema
- `column_names` (List of String) The names of the columns (for column-level privileges)
- `object_names` (List of String) The names of the database objects
